cases.input: Review one bounded pull request against every acceptance criterion and independently assess implementation, tests, security, migrations, architecture, and operational quality with evidence-backed prioritization.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate every acceptance criterion independently from implementation quality
produce evidence-backed prioritized findings with smallest safe remediation
preserve immutable repository state and an explicit review decision
forbiddenBehaviors: approve solely because CI is green
mix requirement coverage and quality observations into one opaque verdict

cases.input: The change is technically clean and CI is green, but one acceptance criterion is missing. Keep the quality axis positive while blocking the requirement axis and the overall decision.
requiredBehaviors: block axis 1 for the missing acceptance criterion
recognize the independently strong implementation quality on axis 2
request the smallest change that closes the missing requirement
forbiddenBehaviors: approve the change because tests and CI are green
invent unrelated quality defects to justify the block
skillAnchors: Ein fehlendes oder falsch umgesetztes Kriterium bleibt blockierend
Grüne CI allein ist niemals hinreichend

cases.input: The proposed review blocks on naming style, duplicates findings, recommends a broad framework rewrite, and approves another change solely from green CI without checking its specification.
requiredBehaviors: reject style-only blocking findings and duplicate findings
restore independent evidence for requirements and delivery quality
forbiddenBehaviors: treat personal style preference as a correctness defect
skillAnchors: Stilpräferenzen, spekulative Architektur und Duplikate sind nicht blockierend
grüne CI nicht mit vollständiger Korrektheit
